rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement, or substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: If your San Francisco landlord serves an eviction notice for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of the unit, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation between 3/1/2026 and 2/28/2027, you are owed $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit. Each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant, or a household with minor children, gets an additional $5,497.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant, max $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 per elderly (60+)/disabled tenant or household with minor children (notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27)

coverage.summary: Tenants in San Francisco evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation; amount depends on date the eviction notice is served.

rules.exemptions: Relocation for temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction: For temporary capital improvement evictions under 20 days, state law (Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9) governs the relocation amount instead of the local ordinance.

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: If your San Francisco landlord serves an Ellis Act eviction notice between 3/1/2026 and 2/28/2027, you are owed $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit. Each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant gets an additional $7,443.90.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 per elderly (62+) or disabled tenant (notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27)

coverage.summary: Tenants in San Francisco evicted under the Ellis Act (withdrawal of units from the rental market); amount depends on date the eviction notice is served.

rules.citation: S.F. Rent Ordinance (Ellis Act relocation payments)
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act

notes: Document is a Rent Board archive table of relocation amounts by notice-service date; only the current period (3/01/26–2/28/27) was extracted. The table cells are on separate lines, so quoted spans use the footnote and section heading rather than the dollar figures. The page does not give the code section for the Ellis Act payments, so that citation is generic. Ellis Act eligibility age is 62+, while the other eviction types use 60+ or households with minor children.
